description: 查询分地区(region)的广告预算(budget)和预算使用率(budget utilization)
query_sql:
select
   grass_month
   ,grass_region
   ,avg(campaign_valid_budget_usd) as campaign_valid_budget_usd
   ,avg(campaign_expenditure_usd)*1.0000/avg(campaign_valid_budget_usd) as budget_utilization
from
   (
       select
           grass_date
           ,substr(cast(grass_date as varchar), 1, 7) as grass_month
           ,grass_region
           ,sum(campaign_valid_budget_usd) as campaign_valid_budget_usd
           ,sum(ads_expenditure_usd) as campaign_expenditure_usd
       from mp_paidads.ads_campaign_valid_budget_1d__reg_s0_live
       where
           grass_date between date('2026-02-01') and date('2026-02-28')
           and grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
       group by 1, 2, 3
   ) t
group by 1, 2
notes: 先按天聚合再按月avg，预算使用率=消耗/有效预算

description: 查询分地区(region)的广告商品GMV占比(ads item gmv%)和广告卖家GMV占比(ads seller gmv%)
query_sql:
with active_ads_item as (
   select
       grass_region
       ,grass_date
       ,cast(shop_id as bigint) as shop_id
       ,item_id
   from mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
   where
       tz_type = 'local'
       and (is_ads_active = 1 or has_performance = 1)
       and placement not in (7)
       and grass_region in ('BR', 'TW', 'ID', 'TH', 'PH', 'MY', 'VN', 'SG')
       and grass_date between date('2026-02-01') and date('2026-02-28')
   group by 1, 2, 3, 4
)
,active_ads_seller as (
   select
       grass_region
       ,grass_date
       ,cast(shop_id as bigint) as shop_id
   from mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
   where
       tz_type = 'local'
       and (is_ads_active = 1 or has_performance = 1)
       and placement not in (7)
       and grass_region in ('BR', 'TW', 'ID', 'TH', 'PH', 'MY', 'VN', 'SG')
       and grass_date between date('2026-02-01') and date('2026-02-28')
   group by 1, 2, 3
)
select
   grass_month
   ,grass_region
   ,avg(gmv_usd_1d) as plt_gmv
   ,avg(ads_item_gmv_usd_1d) as ads_item_gmv_usd
   ,avg(ads_seller_gmv_usd_1d) as ads_seller_gmv_usd_1d
   ,avg(ads_item_gmv_usd_1d)*1.0000/avg(gmv_usd_1d) as ads_item_gmv_per
   ,avg(ads_seller_gmv_usd_1d)*1.0000/avg(gmv_usd_1d) as ads_seller_gmv_per
from (...) a
group by 1, 2
notes: 跨域JOIN：广告mkt表确定活跃广告item/seller，订单归因表(traffic_omni_oa)计算GMV。活跃条件：is_ads_active=1 OR has_performance=1, placement NOT IN (7)

description: 查询分地区(region)的广告卖家渗透率(seller adoption%)，活跃广告卖家占全平台卖家比例
query_sql:
with active_ads_items_advertisers as (
   select grass_date, a.grass_region
       ,coalesce(count(distinct a.shop_id), 0) as active_ads_seller
   from mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live a
   where a.tz_type = 'local'
       and (is_ads_active = 1 or has_performance = 1)
       and a.placement not in (7)
   group by 1, 2
)
,active_seller as (
   select grass_region, grass_date
       ,count(distinct shop_id) as acitve_seller_cnt
   from traffic_omni_oa.dwd_order_item_atc_journey_di__reg_sensitive_live
   where tz_type = 'local' and first_touchpoint_item = 1
       and user_id > 0 and user_id is not null and order_item_id is not null
   group by 1, 2
)
select grass_month, grass_region
   ,avg(active_ads_seller) as active_ads_seller
   ,avg(acitve_seller_cnt) as acitve_seller_cnt
   ,avg(seller_adoption_rate) as seller_adoption_rate
from (
   select a.grass_date, a.grass_region
       ,active_ads_seller, acitve_seller_cnt
       ,active_ads_seller * 1.0000 / acitve_seller_cnt as seller_adoption_rate
   from active_ads_items_advertisers a
   left join active_seller b on a.grass_region = b.grass_region and a.grass_date = b.grass_date
) t
group by 1, 2
notes: 跨域JOIN：广告卖家数/全平台有订单卖家数。活跃广告卖家条件同上。全平台卖家来自订单归因表，需 first_touchpoint_item=1

description: 查询分地区(region)的广告SKU渗透率(sku adoption%)，投放广告的商品占全平台商品比例
query_sql:
select
   grass_region
   ,substr(cast(grass_date as varchar), 1, 7) as grass_month
   ,count(distinct grass_date) as date_cnt
   ,count(distinct item_id) as active_sku_cnt
   ,count(
       distinct case
           when is_active_ads_item = 1 and (ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d > 0 or ads_impression_cnt_1d > 0) then item_id
       end
   ) as active_ads_sku_cnt
   ,count(
       distinct case
           when is_active_ads_item = 1 and (ads_expenditure_amt_usd_1d > 0 or ads_impression_cnt_1d > 0) then item_id
       end
   )*1.0000/count(distinct item_id) as active_ads_sku_per
from mp_paidads.ads_item_supply_1d__reg_s0_live
where
   grass_region in ('BR', 'TW', 'ID', 'TH', 'PH', 'MY', 'VN', 'SG')
   and tz_type = 'local'
group by 1, 2
notes: 单表计算。广告SKU条件：is_active_ads_item=1 AND (expenditure>0 OR impression>0)

description: 查询分地区(region)分天的广告净收入(net revenue)、平台GMV(platform gmv)和广告变现率(take rate)
query_sql:
select
   month(t1.grass_date) as month_rn
   ,grass_date
   ,grass_region
   ,sum(platform_gmv) as platform_gmv
   ,sum(platform_paid_with_placed_cod_gmv) as platform_paid_with_placed_cod_gmv
   ,coalesce(sum(net_ads_rev), 0) - coalesce(sum(ads_voucher_ads_part_amt_usd), 0) as net_rev_excl_roi3_ads_part
   ,coalesce(sum(net_ads_rev), 0) - coalesce(sum(platform_roi3_vourchor_cost), 0) as net_rev_excl_roi3
   ,coalesce(sum(net_ads_rev), 0) as net_rev
   ,coalesce(sum(net_ads_rev), 0)*1.0000/sum(platform_gmv) as take_rate
   ,(coalesce(sum(net_ads_rev), 0) - coalesce(sum(ads_voucher_ads_part_amt_usd), 0))*1.0000/sum(platform_gmv) as take_rate_excl_roi3
from
   (
       select grass_date, grass_region
           ,sum(net_ads_rev_usd) as net_ads_rev
           ,sum(distinct ads_voucher_omni_platform_nmv_cost_usd) as platform_roi3_vourchor_cost
           ,sum(distinct ads_voucher_ads_part_amt_usd) as ads_voucher_ads_part_amt_usd
           ,sum(distinct platform_gmv_excl_testorder) as platform_gmv
           ,sum(distinct platform_paid_with_placed_cod_gmv) as platform_paid_with_placed_cod_gmv
       from mp_paidads.ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live
       where tz_type = 'regional'
       group by 1, 2
   ) t1
group by 1, 2, 3
notes: 使用tz_type='regional'。注意sum(distinct ...)用于预聚合字段去重。take_rate有两个口径：含/不含roi3 voucher

description: 查询分地区(region)分天分流量入口(traffic_type)的广告加载率(ads load)、每次点击成本(CPC)、千次曝光成本(CPM)
query_sql:
select
   grass_region
   ,grass_date
   ,traffic_type
   ,sum(distinct entry_point_imp) as entry_point_imp
   ,sum(ads_imp) as ads_imp
   ,sum(ads_click) as ads_click
   ,sum(raw_ads_rev_usd) as ads_rev_usd
   ,sum(ads_imp)*1.0000/sum(distinct entry_point_imp) as ads_load
   ,sum(raw_ads_rev_usd)*1.0000*1000/sum(ads_click) as cpc
   ,sum(raw_ads_rev_usd)*1.0000*1000/sum(ads_imp) as cpm
from mp_paidads.ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live
where tz_type = 'regional'
group by 1, 2, 3

description: 查询分地区(region)分天分出价类型(pricing_type/product_type)的每次点击成本(CPC)和千次曝光成本(CPM)
query_sql:
select
   grass_region
   ,grass_date
   ,main_product_type
   ,product_type
   ,sub_product_type
   ,sum(ads_imp) as ads_imp
   ,sum(ads_click) as ads_click
   ,sum(raw_ads_rev_usd) as ads_rev_usd
   ,sum(ads_imp)*1.0000/sum(distinct entry_point_imp) as ads_load
   ,sum(raw_ads_rev_usd)*1.0000*1000/sum(ads_click) as cpc
   ,sum(raw_ads_rev_usd)*1.0000*1000/sum(ads_imp) as cpm
from mp_paidads.ads_advertise_take_rate_v2_1d__reg_s0_live
where tz_type = 'regional'
group by 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
notes: 按产品类型（出价类型）拆分的效率指标。使用tz_type='regional'

description: 查询campaign广告活动粒度的曝光(impression)、点击(click)、花费/收入(revenue)、直接GMV(ads_direct_gmv)、宽匹配GMV(ads_broad_gmv)、直接订单(direct_order)、宽匹配订单(broad_order)
query_sql:
select
   grass_region
   ,grass_date
   ,shop_id
   ,campaign_id
   ,sum(impression_cnt) as impression_cnt
   ,sum(click_cnt) as click_cnt
   ,sum(ads_expenditure_amt_usd) as ads_rev
   ,sum(ads_gmv_usd) as ads_gmv_usd
   ,sum(broad_order_gmv_amt_usd) as broad_order_gmv_amt_usd
   ,sum(order_cnt) as direct_order_cnt
   ,sum(broad_order_cnt) as broad_order_cnt
from mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live
where
   tz_type = 'local'
   and (is_ads_active = 1 or has_performance = 1)
group by 1, 2, 3, 4
notes: campaign粒度明细查询。活跃条件：is_ads_active=1 OR has_performance=1

description: 查询GMS达标率（区分target和simple模式）、ROI target2达标率、simple2达标率，按roi_ratio_group分组统计
query_sql:
-- UNION ALL 四段：
-- 1. ROI2 target (pricing_type=11) from roi2_key_metrics
-- 2. ROI2 target (pricing_type=25) from roi2_key_metrics（需先按campaign聚合再汇总）
-- 3. GMS target (pricing_type=24) from ads_gms_shop_metrics_di
-- 4. GMS simple (pricing_type=27) from ads_gms_shop_metrics_di
-- 5. Simple2 (pricing_type=15) from simple2_key_metrics
-- 按 roi_ratio_group_7d 分组统计达标率
notes: 复杂UNION ALL查询，不同pricing_type用不同表。pricing_type: 11=target2, 25=target2(另一类), 24=gms_target, 27=gms_simple, 15=simple2。达标率按roi_ratio_group_7d分组统计

description: 查询分地区(region)的GMV Max产品线活跃广告卖家数(gmv max seller count)，按特定pricing_type过滤
query_sql:
select
   grass_month
   ,grass_region
   ,avg(gmv_max_active_ads_seller) as gmv_max_active_ads_seller
from
   (
       select
           grass_date
           ,substr(cast(grass_date as varchar), 1, 7) as grass_month
           ,grass_region
           ,coalesce(count(distinct a.shop_id), 0) as gmv_max_active_ads_seller
       from mp_paidads.ads_advertise_mkt_1d__reg_s0_live a
       where
           a.tz_type = 'local'
           and (is_ads_active = 1 or has_performance = 1)
           and a.placement not in (7)
           and pricing_type in (11, 20, 24, 25, 27, 15)
       group by 1, 2, 3
   ) a
group by 1, 2
notes: 统计gmv max产品线(pricing_type in 11,20,24,25,27,15)的活跃广告卖家数。先按天count distinct再按月avg
